description: This file defines the ChooseKeyDialog class, a GUI dialog component for selecting or creating a cryptographic key within an Android project, including handling user interactions and key selection logic.

classes.name: ChooseKeyDialog
classes.description: A dialog for choosing or creating a cryptographic key, with options for selecting existing keys or generating new ones, integrated with Android project signing.

classes.name: MyNewKeyForm
classes.description: Inner class extending NewKeyForm, providing project-specific context and key store details for key creation.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Creates and returns the main panel component of the dialog.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Handles the OK button action, creating a new key if selected, with error handling.

methods.name: getChosenKey
methods.description: Returns the selected key alias, either from existing keys or newly created.

methods.name: getChosenKeyPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the chosen key if a new key is being created.
